requirements.text: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production web applications
Strong proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript across both frontend and backend contexts
Hands-on experience with React and at least one backend framework (Node.js/Express, NestJS, Django, or FastAPI)
Working knowledge of relational databases, schema design, and query performance tuning
Experience with Git-based workflows, code review culture, and CI/CD pipelines
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
Bonus: Experience with Go, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code (Terraform); prior startup experience; contributions to open-source projects
